component.name: Versionary
component.summary: A fast, native Git GUI client

description.p: Versionary is a free, open-source Git client with a native Qt interface. It provides repository tabs and workspaces, staging with partial line selection, a graphical commit history, branching, stashing, submodules, and OAuth for GitHub, Bitbucket, and GitLab — without the resource footprint of an Electron app.
